\caption{Per-strategy win/tie rates on multiclass cost-matrix objectives. Each cell reads ``$r{\pm}H$'': $r$ is the percentage of (dataset, model, objective) cells in the slice where the strategy won or tied the per-row best under the $\pm 1$ SE overlap rule, and $H$ is the half-width of a 95\% bootstrap interval over cells for $r$ (percentage points). Shading is a quadratic ($\mathrm{rate}^2$) scale of $r$. Strategies are sorted by overall win rate; ``$n$'' under each column header is the maximum applicable cell count for that slice.}%
\label{fig:win-counts-multiclass-cost}
\end{figure}
